name: Returning Home
summary: In human lands, a night elf priest receives a summons to return to Teldrassil. Brother Joshua delivers the message from Priestess Alathea, who calls the young priest to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus for advanced guidance in Elune’s mysteries.

sections.title: A Summons Across Seas
sections.body: Night elf priests sometimes travel to human lands such as Stormwind to share spiritual fellowship with the Church of the Holy Light. Their deepest ties remain with the Sisterhood of Elune. Brother Joshua tells an acolyte that a night elf emissary has come searching for them. Their early travels are over, and their home temple calls them back for deeper training with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind’s inner circle.

sections.title: The Temple of the Moon
sections.body: Across the sea, Darnassus welcomes the returning priest at the Temple of the Moon. Priestess Alathea greets the acolyte warmly and celebrates their safe passage through a troubled world. Their return brings joy to Alathea and Tyrande, while more demanding spiritual trials await.

faq.q: Why is Brother Joshua giving instructions to a night elf priest?
faq.answer: Brother Joshua serves the Church of the Holy Light in human lands, where young Alliance priests often train together. A sister of Elune came to his halls with a message recalling you to Darnassus, and Joshua passes on the summons.

Priestess Alathea is a senior member of the Sisterhood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She works with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and oversees the training and advancement of promising night elf priests.

faq.q: What happens after reaching the Temple of the Moon?
faq.answer: At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess Alathea welcomes you home and begins your next rite of passage. Stars of Elune deepens your communion with the Moon Goddess.

faq.q: Can any Alliance race do this quest?
aliases: who can pick up returning home
faq.answer: This summons is for night elf priests who have traveled far from Kalimdor during their early training. It calls you home to study the traditions of your people’s priesthood with the Sisterhood of Elune.

faq.q: Where is the Temple of the Moon located?
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon is in Darnassus’s southern district, atop the boughs of Teldrassil. It is the spiritual heart of night elf culture and the seat of power for High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

faq.q: Why does Alathea mention Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind is the High Priestess of Elune and spiritual leader of the night elves. Senior priestesses such as Alathea act on her behalf, tracking and guiding novices who represent their faith abroad according to Tyrande’s standards.

angles.text: As a priest, you return from fellowship with the Church of the Holy Light to the Sisterhood of Elune, where you can master Kaldorei rites.
As a night elf priest who has walked among humans or dwarves across the sea, you make a sacred return to the sanctuaries of Teldrassil.
Brother Joshua in the Eastern Kingdoms and the priestesses in Darnassus work together, reflecting the spiritual ties that unite the Alliance.
